title: Ringed forgetting preserves evaluation on K-flat and K-injective models
statement: Let (C,J,R) and (D,Jprime,Rprime) be ringed sites with independent universes [def-weil-size-convention], module-sheaf categories B and A [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let U:B to A be additive and exact, preserving K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Fix the underived tensor and sheaf-Hom comparisons preserving canonical evaluation [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data, def-pur-sheaf-hom, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with their Hom complexes and total tensors [def-pur-hom-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Fix the closed structures and normalized tensor models [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal, def-pur-derived-internal-hom, lem-sf-ringed-derived-tensor-hom-adjunction, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], the two-injective Hom comparison chi [lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom], and tensor comparison m [lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-descent]. Assume U preserves flat-term K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every flat-term K-flat P and K-injective I, the inverse tensor comparison on (RHom(QP,QI),QP), followed by F of source derived evaluation, equals target tensor of the specified Hom comparison and the identity, followed by target derived evaluation. This is evaluation compatibility only for the displayed representatives, with no assertion about arbitrary derived objects or inverse transposes.

proof.text: Resolve Hom(P,I) by a flat-term K-flat complex Q with quasi-isomorphism q. The hypotheses provide flat-term K-flat UQ and UP. Form the source ordinary uncurry of q and the target ordinary uncurry of U(q) followed by the chain Hom comparison.

The chain-uncurrying theorem identifies these two chain maps along the specified tensor comparison. The existing tensor-curry normalization and model-evaluation formula identify their localizations with the source and target derived evaluations on these models.

The normalized Hom representative formula on q identifies the two Hom-model arrows. The given tensor representative square identifies the tensor-model arrows. Apply the general evaluation-of-models cancellation lemma with these squares, the localization-factor isomorphisms, and the two uncurried maps. It cancels the localized q and model isomorphisms, yielding exactly evaluation compatibility for QP and QI.

theorem ringed_forget_representative_evaluation
    (m : TensorComparison.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
      J R J' R' U u SB TB βB cB SA TA βA cA)
    (preserves_flat_models :
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ,
        P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
        (∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R) (P.X p)) →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R')
          ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
        ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{d, vd, max d vd s, max d vd s}
          (R := R') (U.obj (P.X p)))
    (P I : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (fP : ∀ n, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R) (P.X n))
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    m.derived.inv.app ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, wb} J R).obj
        (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I), DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        U.mapDerivedCategory.map (SB.evaluation (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) =
      SA.tensor.map
        (X := (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, wb} J R).obj
          (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)),
          U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
        (Y := ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{d, vd, s, wa} J' R').obj
          (op (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)),
            U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)),
          U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
        (χ.derived.hom.app (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I), 𝟙 _) ≫
          SA.evaluation (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
          (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
